name: rotate_byte_reset_record_flag

name: call_routine_five_times

name: write_dma_channel_bits

name: call_routine_four_times

name: set_record_fields_from_byte

name: call_routines_conditionally

name: decrement_counter_reload_five

name: call_routine_four_times
description: Invokes one unnamed routine four times in succession and returns with no other work.

name: copy_three_bytes_from_table

name: call_routine_four_times

name: advance_pointer_after_countdown

name: call_routine_four_times

name: transfer_pending_record_to_dest

name: call_routine_four_times

name: select_output_pair_from_record

name: call_routine_four_times

name: load_next_table_entry

name: call_routine_four_times

name: copy_longword_from_offset
